nodes.description: Get current stock market index data
nodes.agent_prompt: Retrieve the current performance data for major stock market indices such as the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite. Focus on today's date.

Summarize the retrieved stock market index data, highlighting the performance of the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite for today. Provide key figures like current values and daily changes.

nodes.description: Get current stock market index data

code_variants.CODE_1A:
data = json.loads(search_web_with_text_content('S&P 500 Dow Jones Nasdaq Composite today performance', 5))
return {'major_indices_data_T001': data}
code_variants.CODE_1B:
urls = json.loads(web_search('S&P 500 today', 3))
content_sp500 = webpage_url_to_raw_text(urls[0] if urls else '')
urls = json.loads(web_search('Dow Jones Industrial Average today', 3))
content_dowjones = webpage_url_to_raw_text(urls[0] if urls else '')
urls = json.loads(web_search('Nasdaq Composite today', 3))
content_nasdaq = webpage_url_to_raw_text(urls[0] if urls else '')
return {'major_indices_data_T001': {'sp500': content_sp500, 'dowjones': content_dowjones, 'nasdaq': content_nasdaq}}
